'''Rudrig''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Description==
Rudrig was a lush<ref name="Xim Week" /> and quiet planet where weapons were prohibited. It was home to the vast [[University of Rudrig/Legends|University of Rudrig]], arguably the Hegemony's best post-secondary school. The university had campuses and classrooms scattered everywhere amid the gray soil and purple grasses of Rudrig.<ref name="TCSWE" />

[[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] was from Rudrig.<ref name="Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

==History==
One of the original member-worlds of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]]. After the empire collapsed, it continued to thrive as a world of the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]], eventually being part of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] when the Tion Cluster joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

In the Republic's final years, the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] worlds joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and were later members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were involved in a high-speed chase on a Rudrig freeway during one of their early adventures.<ref name="TCSWE" />

A Rudrig crime ring later tortured a kidnap victim by using an Imperial [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] stolen from a battle zone, one impetus behind the [[Historical Battle Site Preservation Act]] established by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> The sector was later represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Nyxy]] from Rudrig.<ref name="TNR" />
